item.title: Judge reinstates Manor girls basketball eligibility, halts Hampton/Warhill game
item.description: Circuit Court Judge Brenda Spry granted a temporary injunction Friday, reinstating the eligibility of the Manor High School girls' basketball team. The ruling also halts the Virginia High School League (VHSL) tournament from proceeding.
